$comment: Binding contract (PRD FR-5, Section 14). Deny-by-default: only tools listed in 'allowed' may reach the Zoho MCP server. Widening this list is a deliberate, reviewed scope decision — never inferred from tools/list. Argument names verified against the live Zoho schemas on 2026-11-10 (data_select, not dataSelect).

allowed.name: getLeaveBalance
allowed.purpose: Leave balance for the signed-in employee

allowed.name: fetchLeaveTypes
allowed.purpose: Leave types available to the signed-in employee

allowed.name: getEmployeeShiftDetails
allowed.purpose: Shift details - self scope only (emailId is bound to the caller by the MCP client)
